units.source_text: 今天，小野田六段在秋季升段赛结束之后，也前来列席观战。

en.t: Today, after the autumn promotion tournament had ended, Onoda Sixth Dan also came to attend and watch the game.

units.source_text: 此外，还有八幡干事、五井和砂田两位记者，以及《东京日日新闻》驻伊东的通讯员等。

en.t: In addition, there were Secretary Yahata, the two reporters Goi and Sunada, and the Tokyo Nichinichi Shimbun correspondent stationed in Ito, among others.

units.source_text: 这盘棋的工作人员也都聚拢过来观看接近尾声的终盘。

en.t: The staff for this match also gathered around to watch the endgame as it neared its conclusion.

units.source_text: 贴邻的另一个房间里挤满了人，有的就站在隔扇后边。

en.t: The adjoining room was packed with people, and some stood behind the sliding partitions.

units.source_text: 名人向他们招呼，请他们进来观摩。

en.t: The Master called out to them and invited them to come in and observe.
